name: ARTEMISIA VULGARIS
key_symptoms: Drawn back by spasmodic twitchings. Mouth drawn to left. Congestion of brain.
guiding_symptoms: Drawn back by spasmodic twitchings. Mouth drawn to left. Congestion of brain.
head_symptoms: Drawn back by spasmodic twitchings. Mouth drawn to left. Congestion of brain.
urinary_symptoms: Profuse menses. Violent uterine contractions. Spasms during menses.
